name: Image Processing
description: Inspect, edit, compose, convert, and compare bounded raster images with isolated Debian image tooling.
capabilities: inspect image dimensions, formats, orientation, metadata and colors
resize, crop, rotate, flip, trim and pad images
convert PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF images with bounded quality settings
strip sensitive image metadata and normalize orientation
adjust image levels, colors, opacity, quantization, blur and sharpness
overlay images and add bounded text watermarks
create contact sheets and montages from several images
compare images numerically and produce visual difference images
process inline base64 images or shared artifacts without network access
report available ImageMagick and Pillow engines and image limits

backend.description: Preferred engine. auto uses ImageMagick first and Pillow for unsupported capabilities.

maxMemoryMb.description: Highest address-space limit for one image worker. Omit to size it from node memory.

maxTimeoutMs.description: Highest wall-clock limit for one image operation.

concurrentCalls.description: Image calls this node may execute concurrently. Omit to size it from CPU and memory.

callsPerMinute.description: Calls this installation accepts per minute. Omit to derive it from concurrency.
